subject: Duplicate charge on May invoice — request for goodwill offset & VAT correction
messages:
From: Alex Hsu <alex.hsu@brightlane.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: billing@brightlane.com
Date: Sat, 02 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Duplicate charge on May invoice — needs correction

Hi Kimberly,

Hope you're well. We received May's invoice this morning (invoice_20260501.pdf attached) and it looks like two line items for the same Dedicated capacity block were billed — one for our committed pool and one for a short burst (the burst should have been offset against our committed units). That results in a duplicate charge of $3,200.

Separately, the VAT treatment on the invoice shows UK VAT applied; we've previously submitted our VAT registration and expect a zero-rated (reverse charge) entry for Redwood services. I've attached our VAT certificate again for your records.

Can you advise the timeline to:
- issue a credit for the duplicate item (preferably a goodwill offset so it clears our accounts receivable)
- correct the VAT on the invoice or issue a corrected invoice/credit note

We're running month-end close next week so any credits issued by 2026-05-05 would be ideal. Let me know if you need anything else from our side.

Thanks,
Alex Hsu
Director of Finance
Brightlane Inc

Attachments: invoice_20260501.pdf (PDF, 82KB); vat_certificate_brightlane.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

Hi Alex — thanks for flagging this and for sending the VAT cert. Really sorry for the hassle.

Immediate plan:
- I'm looping in Marissa from Billing to validate the duplicate charge and prepare a credit note.
- Sean (Finance Ops) will confirm whether we can apply a goodwill offset to clear the AR balance before your close.
- If approved, we'll post a corrected invoice/credit note with the VAT correction and send both the PDF and the accounting reference back to you.

Can you confirm the amount you see as duplicate ($3,200) and whether you want the credit applied against the open invoice or issued as a standalone credit note? Either is fine but we want to match your AR process.

I'll follow up by EOD Monday with a firm ETA.

Best,

Kim / Sean — I reviewed the billing tickets and invoice line items. Summary of findings:
- Invoice 20260501 contains two entries for 'Dedicated - c5.large (committed)' covering the same 720 GPU-hours window. One line was supposed to be a credit allocation for a previously issued overage; instead it was billed as a charge.
- Duplicate amount: $3,200 (matches Alex's note).
- VAT was applied at 20% because the system didn't detect Brightlane's VAT exemption flag due to a missing tax_id on file.

Proposed remediation steps (we can execute today):
1) Issue a goodwill offset credit note (CR-BR-2026-05) for $3,200 applied to invoice 20260501 so AR shows a zeroed duplicate line.
2) Issue a corrected invoice PDF with VAT reversed and attach the credit note. We'll include accounting references for your AP team.
3) If Brightlane prefers a standalone refund instead of an AR offset, we can do a one-time refund (wire) — needs Finance Ops approval; Sean, please confirm cutoff for same-week wire.

I've prepared draft credit_note_BR-2026-05.pdf (stub) and the corrected invoice draft. Attaching both to this thread for review before sending to the customer.

Marissa Cole
Billing Specialist, Redwood Inference

Attachments: credit_note_BR-2026-05.pdf (PDF, 9KB); corrected_invoice_20260501_draft.pdf (PDF, 84KB)
